target_test: bayesianUpdate keeps a fresh rule's posterior non-degenerate
rationale: bayesianUpdate with priorCount=0 (every rule from fromRecurrenceRecords starts at SelectionCount=0) collapses the posterior to exactly 1.0/0.0 on the first observation — one data point becomes certainty. Add Beta(1,1)-style pseudo-counts so the posterior stays strictly inside (0,1). Research: docs/research/theory-bayesian-grammar-induction.md.

target_test: updateWeight folds the Bayesian posterior into the ranking Weight
rationale: updateWeight advances SuccessRate/Confidence but never touches Weight, the field classifyWeighted actually ranks by — so execution outcomes can never change promotion order, and live promotion state shows r(SuccessRate, Weight) = -0.85. Recompute Weight from the posterior on each update (respect MinWeight). Research: docs/research/theory-bayesian-grammar-induction.md, empirical-promotion-dynamics.md.
